known_deltas: Phase 1 + 2.0-2.2 complete (details in git history; CVI formula, quirks, packs documented in AGENTS.md).
LanguagePack contract evolution (2.2, commit 3891cc2): detect_heuristic(text)->float default 0; default-impl verified by test_grc_inherits_default_heuristic; documented in AGENTS.

Detect algorithm refinement (2.2 #4): TWO-PHASE - (1) unicode-ranges max-hits wins (alphabet decides), (2) heuristic at tie/absence; deterministic alphabetical tie-break + detect_ambiguous log (candidates/winner/method).

la heuristic refinement (2.2 #3): DISTINCT function words (repeat 'in' doesn't score); tests: in_vitro / et_al / per_se / english-repeats -> None. Threshold/weights hardcoded Classical -> backlog (AEON_LA_DETECT_THRESHOLD idea).
la limitation (2.2 #5): heuristic tuned for Classical Latin; Medieval/Neo-Latin may underdetect (documented).

Phase 2.3 (this commit): aeon/fragments/ (hypothesis/ranking/engine/__init__); flow: pack markers -> density -> cruces-only early no_reconstruction -> LLM 2-4 hypotheses -> cap 4 -> max<0.5 threshold -> per-hypothesis Detective -> drop contradicted -> all_contradicted. reasons: cruces_without_external_evidence | max_confidence_below_threshold | all_contradicted | no_markers | llm_unavailable | llm_parse_error | llm_returned_none.

Stop-point decisions 2.3: #1 variants=contested readings -> backlog F2.4+ (Sappho runs normal fragment path); #2 each hypothesis -> Detective (N calls; ~+2s/hypothesis real; batching if >30s - backlog 2.7); #3 reconstruct prompt = pack prompts + DEFAULT_RECONSTRUCT_PROMPT (<=30 lines each); #4 no_reconstruction = TERMINAL verdict + reason as structured signal for external sources (F2.6).
Bare ellipsis '…' added to grc/la lacuna tokens (spec alignment; Sappho uses bare '…'); prose-ellipsis false-positive risk noted.
translator metadata['reconstruction'] = to_dict() (JSON-serializable; .aeon v2 storage - F3). Config: CONFIG.fragments + AEON_FRAGMENT_* env.
backlog: 2.4 Linguistic Layers (lexical->syntactic->semantic->pragmatic); variant readings mode (kind=variant, choose between editions) for contested readings
2.6 Pleiades offline dump adapter + Trismegistos datasets adapter + per-file corpus licenses
2.7 Real API verification when key available; hypothesis-verification batching/parallelism if >30s/atom
la heuristic: move threshold/weights to config (AEON_LA_DETECT_THRESHOLD); Medieval/Neo-Latin tuning
fragment density threshold tuning on real corpora
Phase 3: .aeon v2 (verification trace, entity links, hypotheses), CLI/web endpoints, README v4, morphology (Morpheus/CLTK optional), search-layer sigma unification
